name: esp32-s31-wroom-3
title: ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 module body
summary: Shielded radio module body with four pad rows, a ground array and corner pads: board, ENIG pads, nickel-silver can, printed antenna. Defaults are the ESP32-S31-WROOM-3's.
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored`. Dimensions from Espressif's public ESP32-S31-WROOM-3 datasheet v0.7 (see examples/esp32-s31-wroom-3/); no CAD or EDA library data was copied.
